method: Direct inspection of all twelve iteration-28 Poppler page PNGs using view_image; no clipping, overlap, broken glyphs, unreadable legends, table overflow, or stranded bibliography page found.

observations.1-4: Reframed title, abstract, introduction, equations, geometry and architecture readable.
observations.5-8: Decoder, weights, training plot, response annotations, subsystem labels and table readable.
observations.9-12: Ratio labels clear; interpretation, scope, conclusion, metadata and complete bibliography readable.

prior_findings: QA27 passed automated checks but visual review rejected a nearly empty thirteenth bibliography page. Iteration 28 uses smaller standard bibliography type, restores balanced 12-page pagination, and passes direct review. Earlier semantic and visual failures remain preserved.
